g.text: 01 / DEVLENS
AI-powered onboarding tool that helps new developers understand codebases fast.
Visualizes dependencies, maps issues to code, explains architecture via a "Digital Senior Mentor" interface.
PYTHON · AI · CODEBASE ANALYSIS · DEVELOPER TOOLING
02 / DATATHON-2026
Conversational AI for law-enforcement investigators to query a crime database in plain English or Kannada.
Every answer grounded in visible data references, confidence indicators, and anti-hallucination safeguards.
PYTHON · NLP · LLM · DATA-GROUNDED QA · DATATHON 2026
03 / GALLA-SAATHI
Voice-first AI copilot for Indian kirana shopkeepers, built on a fine-tuned Gemma model.
Helps underbanked retail owners manage credit, inventory and ledgers via voice — Hindi, Punjabi, code-switched English.
TYPESCRIPT · GEMMA · VOICE AI · FINTECH FOR RETAIL
04 / DEBATEMIND
AI system that simulates structured debates between two agents.
A reinforcement-learning model learns which argument strategies work best, scored by a neutral judge model.
PYTHON · REINFORCEMENT LEARNING · MULTI-AGENT AI
05 / SANN
Self-Auditing Neural Networks — models that examine and evaluate their own performance and behavior.
Explores self-diagnostic mechanisms for catching model failure modes before they reach production.
PYTHON · NEURAL NETWORKS · MODEL AUDITING · ML RESEARCH
06 / CREATOR_X
SocialFi platform combining social networking with Web3, built as backend, contracts and app.
Smart contracts for token-based creator economics, paired with a dedicated backend and frontend app.
SOLIDITY · SMART CONTRACTS · SOCIALFI · WEB3
